name: glass-search-bar
summary: A floating glass search pill that swells on focus as a cancel button splits off.
props: Controlled or uncontrolled query; clear and cancel report ''.
Placeholder, also the field's accessibility label.
Called with the query when the keyboard's search key is pressed.
A glass cancel button springs in beside the pill while focused or holding text.
Text for the cancel button, e.g. "Cancel"; without it the button is a round ✕.
After cancel clears the query and dismisses the keyboard.
Replaces the magnifier at the start of the pill.
Inside the pill at the end, e.g. a mic button.
Force light or dark glass and ink, e.g. 'dark' over a photo.
44 / 52pt tall; font, icons and padding scale too.
Row holding the pill and the cancel button.
editable, returnKeyType, onFocus, onBlur, onSubmitEditing, … (ref forwards to the TextInput).
behavior: The pill swells a touch on focus and a clear button pops in once there is text. With showCancel, a glass cancel button springs in beside it while searching.
The pill no longer swells, and the clear and cancel buttons fade in with a short timing instead of a spring.
The return key reads Search and calls onSubmit with the query. Cancel clears the text and dismisses the keyboard.
The field has the search role and is labelled by its placeholder. The clear and cancel buttons read "Clear search" and cancelLabel (or "Cancel search").
Real Liquid Glass on iOS 26, where the pill and cancel button melt together. Blur or frosted glass everywhere else.
